reasonAndRepair.TypeScript: It is the one name that could be an error or an event, and a reader has to find the declaration to learn which. Use "{{suggestedName}}" or a more descriptive name.
reasonAndRepair.Swift: It is the one name that could be an error or an event, and a reader has to find the declaration to learn which. Use "{{suggestedName}}" or a more descriptive name.
reasonAndRepair.Go: It reads as an error by habit, so a reader has to find the declaration to learn whether it holds one or something else. Rename it to {{suggestedName}}.

noSingleLetter.text: Single-letter identifier "{{name}}" is not descriptive enough. The name is read everywhere it is used and declared only once, so the saving is at the declaration and the cost is at every call site.

noUnderscore.text: Identifier "_" is not descriptive enough. Name it explicitly, or prefix an underscore to a real name such as "_event" when the point is that the value is deliberately unused.
